bounded_paraphrase: The documented API uses seconds and nanoseconds in a timespec interval. An interrupted call returns minus one with EINTR and can supply a remaining interval for another call. Actual scheduling can exceed the requested interval.
scope: External API semantic context only; not an original target header, executed provider/kernel, firmware observation, valid-input test or measured timing.
